answer: A credential is only as strong as the people who would notice its absence. Commissioned harbour pilot registration with harbour authority attestation is noticed through a registration the authority renews after pilotage audits. The echo is the community around the holder — colleagues, examiners, clients who expect the name on the register. Faking a hundred holders means faking a hundred such communities, and the sable is the cost of the first community: years of shared work, none of it stageable in a week. The pulse is the register itself, public and searchable by anyone.
